recommendation: Keep this commit. Continue the separate unresolved question of whether the example URI values should resolve as formal NamingSystems, live in THO, or be represented differently under FHIR-51533 or another explicit OO/terminology decision.
issue_request: FHIR-32553 was a Published OO change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking how implementers should find Device.udiCarrier issuer and jurisdiction URIs. The accepted resolution added example issuer URIs and jurisdiction URIs to the Device.udiCarrier definitions.
initial_application: The issue was applied by FHIR-32553 commits a98f426dc9 and cc51b0a9, which changed source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml. The current source had the jurisdiction example but the issuer definition retained a US-FDA-only qualifier, misspelled ICCBBA as ICCBA for one example, and collapsed the IFA example into item 4 with a literal # separator.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists device=Device as an active resource and maps device to OO, so the Device StructureDefinition is in current build scope. source/device/device.svg has a checked-in tooltip copied from the issuer definition. Later FHIR-35973 changed issuer cardinality and is already represented on the combined branch. Later FHIR-51533 and Zulip threads identify unresolved THO/NamingSystem registration and validation questions, but FHIR-51533 is still Waiting for Input and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml to say 'UDI issuers include', restored ICCBBA spelling for other devices, and split IFA into item 5. Updated source/device/device.svg with the same tooltip text so the checked-in Device diagram does not contradict the authoritative definition.
source_changes: source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml: clarified Device.udiCarrier.issuer examples from 'US FDA issuers' to 'UDI issuers', corrected ICCBBA spelling, and made IFA a fifth example item.
source/device/device.svg: synchronized the Device diagram tooltip with the corrected issuer definition.

related_jiras.note: Changed Device.udiCarrier.issuer cardinality to 1..1 after FHIR-32553; already represented on the combined branch and not republished.
Open Waiting for Input issue about the listed udiCarrier.issuer identifiers not being defined in THO; useful context but not final enough to decide in this seed run.
